wa_rpm.notes: MP: P1 a short, dirty, sparsely bolted 5.10d slab (a 5.0 bypass 30 ft right); P2 dihedral to a roof about 35 m up, over 60 m long, 70 m rope; then Outer Space. Stored approach_variants facts agree with MP. Its line 'a Northwest Forest Pass is required' is incomplete (the $5 day fee and interagency passes also work) - fixed in the proposed permit/access text, prose left. Separate sibling row wa_rpm_2nd_pitch_early_exit (MP 5.9) also has pitches 0. Trailhead pin reused from the live locked sibling value (wa_snow_creek_wall_remorse etc.; OSM lot way 154033355 + USFS trailhead page). Land: USFS ownership layer = Okanogan-Wenatchee NF; USFS wilderness layer puts the USGS 'Snow Creek Wall' cliff point inside the Alpine Lakes Wilderness, boundary about 100 m west. USFS Enchantments page (updated 2026-06-22): a permit is required for day AND overnight use inside the Enchantment Permit Area, free and self-issued at the trailheads; overnight permits May 15-Oct 31. Whether the wall itself lies inside the Enchantment Permit Area (rather than just the wilderness) is not stated on either page, so the proposed text names the trailhead's day-use wilderness permit only. No official raptor closure for Snow Creek Wall found (MP mentions monitoring only; the Bridge Creek Wall eagle closure is a different wall).
